name: Designer Logo Underwear
summary: Plain cotton underwear with the name of a fashion designer on the waistband. In 1982 a fashion house put its name on a basic brief, and underwear became a branded, advertised object.

philosophy.core_thesis: A basic garment gains value from its maker's name: the plain brief stays plain, and the label on the band carries the brand.
design_principles: Keep the garment plain: cotton jersey, a clean cut and a flat seam.
Weave the maker's name in large capitals into the elastic waistband, 3 to 4 cm deep.
Pick one tone for the band, and set the name in a second tone with high contrast.
Cut the brief from jersey with 5 per cent elastane for a close fit.
Sell the garment in a plain pack with the name on it and a clean photograph.
Extend the same band to boxer shorts, bras and other basics.
Keep the colour range small: white, grey, black and navy.
anti_patterns: A loud print that hides the band
A name too small to read
A rough seam that marks the skin

silhouette.shape: A close, plain brief or short boxer, with a wide, visible waistband that carries the name.
silhouette.line: A straight, level band at the hip, and a clean leg line.
silhouette.fit: Close and smooth; the elastane gives a steady hold with no wrinkle.
silhouette.proportion: Band 3 to 4 cm deep; rise 22 to 28 cm for the brief; boxer leg 10 to 15 cm.
rules: Weave the name in capitals along the full band.
Keep the band one tone and the letters a high-contrast tone.
Cut the garment in plain jersey with no print.
Bind the leg with a narrow band of the same jersey.
Put a small woven label at the back.

fabrics.rule: Use plain combed cotton jersey, and weave the name into a jacquard elastic band.

methods: combed cotton jersey with a little elastane
jacquard elastic woven with the name
flat seam at the leg and the side
boxer in woven poplin with an elastic waist
construction.closures: No closure: an elastic waistband; the boxer has a button fly.
construction.details: The name along the band, a woven label at the back, a small flag at the side seam, and a plain pack.

surface.pattern: Plain tone for the body; a woven or printed name on the waistband; a stripe or check only on the woven boxer.
surface.gloss: Cotton jersey at 3–8 GU; mercerised cotton at 8–15 GU.
surface.wear: The band stays crisp with the name legible after many washes; the colour fades slowly.

palette.strategy: White, grey, black and navy; the name on the band is the only graphic.

processes: cotton jersey knitted in the round
jacquard elastic woven with the name
pack and photograph made in the house
making.scale: Made by a licensed factory in large lots for a designer house; sold in department stores and in the house shop.
making.signs: A name on the waistband, plain jersey, a flat seam, and a woven label at the back.

pieces.form: Cotton brief with the name woven in the waistband
Woven boxer in poplin with a name band
Brief with a jacquard elastic that carries the name in capitals
Plain stretch cotton bra with a name band

positive: flat packshot on a plain ground

canonical_works.work: Men's underwear line with a name band

evidence.title: Cotton brief with maker name on the waistband, flat scan, 2008

emotion.target_response: A sense of status in a small, plain object: the viewer sees a clean garment and a known name.

use_cases: a flat product shot of branded basics
a museum label or object study
avoid_when: the brief wants an unbranded, plain garment
the brief wants lace or lingerie

modifiers.how: Remove the woven name, keep the cotton jersey and the Y-shaped fly, and use a plain elastic band.
Show the band above the trouser line or the skirt, and pair the basics with a jacket or a dress.

ornament_level.note: The name on the band is the only ornament.
